comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body:
Phase 1 (rebar-debug) — ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED (runtime-proven, offline + live).

## Mechanism (single root cause)
The DC rich-text failures are a SYMPTOM of a `sync --only`-generic apply-dispatch drop — NOT a codec/differ/overlay defect. Under the PRIMARY route `sync --only=<local_id>,<key>` (Mode.LIVE, route="sync", selection_ids set), an outbound scalar UPDATE on a BOUND issue is planned as `scope_deferred` and never written; the legacy route `--mode live --filter-local-ids` writes it correctly.

Chain:
- run_differs builds the outbound update and appends the typed Mutation with `target = om.jira_key` (the Jira KEY) — run_differs.py:582-599.
- run_differs.py:293-302 calls `ticket_planner.plan_pass(selection={"kind": selection_kind, "ids": sorted(selection_ids)})` — the ids are the SELECTED LOCAL IDS only.
- `ticket_planner._scope_excluded(target, selection)` (ticket_planner.py:95) does `target not in ids` for kind="only". For an update, target is the JIRA KEY but ids are LOCAL IDS, so the in-scope bound-issue update is classified out-of-scope → `_classify_early` returns `PlanDisposition.defer / scope_deferred` (ticket_planner.py:124).
- `batch_dispatch.reroute_migrated_plans` counts the deferred plan as migrated, EXCLUDES its real mutation dict from the legacy `_apply_batch` loop, and hands it to `coordinate_and_fuse`, whose coordinator SKIPS any non-`mutate` plan without calling execute. Net: the write is dropped (deferred_count=1); handle_update / update_issue / Issue.update never fire.

The legacy `--filter-local-ids` route works because it scopes via `_build_filter_target_set` (reconcile_helpers.py), which expands to LOCAL IDS ∪ their BOUND JIRA KEYS, so `_mutation_matches_filter` matches jira-key-targeted updates. The primary route's planner scope check never got that expansion. Because the description write never lands, remote stays None and every subsequent pass re-derives description!=wire and re-emits — the perpetual re-push (symptom 2) and empty render (symptom 1) both follow from the dropped write.

## Proof (discriminating, runtime)
- Live in-CI agentic probe (run 33129851229) instrumented in-subprocess: under `sync --only`, breadcrumb `RECON: outbound_update changed=[description]` fires but handle_update / _IssuesMixin.update_issue / _update_one_scalar_update / Issue.update NEVER fire (ev-0033/0036/0037/0038/0048), remote stays None (ev-0049); the same value via Mode.LIVE `--filter-local-ids` applies ("OK: applied 1 of 1", ev-0041/0042) and the next `sync --only` pass then reports outbound_differ total=0 (ev-0043/0044). Summary drops the same way (ev-0039/0040), proving it is not rich-text-specific.
- Offline deterministic reproduction (fake transport, this worktree): Route A `selection_kind="only", route="sync"` → update_issue NOT fired; Route B `filter_local_ids` → `update_issue(DIG-1) fields=['description']` fired. Trace shows the plan disposition is `defer` (A) vs `mutate` (B); the mutation is identical after run_differs on both routes.

## Attribution
`--class=regression`, `--caused-by=67d4-ecba-cf95-4353` (commit d49466b5 "Wire live coordinator+fuse non-create reroute", 2026-08-25). The defective scope check (`_scope_excluded` comparing a jira-key target against a local-id selection) was authored shadow-only in 85f8-de1a-e425-4584 (commit 6bcf548d, plan-lifecycle planner) where it only fed a parity comparison and dropped nothing. It became a live WRITE DROP when 67d4 made the coordinator+fuse reroute the authoritative dispatch path for non-create mutations without ensuring in-scope bound-issue updates classify as `mutate`. Before 67d4, `sync --only` applied updates via the legacy `_apply_batch` loop; 67d4 is the change a reviewer could have caught the drop in. Divergence from a whole-file blame majority noted: the fix lands in run_differs/ticket_planner, but the regression is attributed to the reroute cutover that activated the latent scope-check defect.

## Fix (Phase 2)
Expand the selection ids handed to the planner to LOCAL IDS ∪ their BOUND JIRA KEYS (parity with the legacy `_build_filter_target_set`), so a bound-issue update (target=jira_key) is recognized in-scope and planned `mutate`. RED oracle: a scoped `sync --only` pass with a bound-issue scalar drift must dispatch the write (currently RED for `--only`, GREEN for `--filter-local-ids`).

comments.body:
Phase 2 (rebar-debug) — FIX LANDED FOR REVIEW (Gerrit change 2305).

## Fix
Added pure helper `run_differs._scoped_selection_ids(selection_ids, typed_mutations)` that expands the shadow planner's selection ids to LOCAL IDS ∪ their BOUND JIRA KEYS, read purely from the mutations' own provenance (no binding_store I/O — the shadow layer stays side-effect-free). Wired it into the single `plan_pass` call site (run_differs.py). A bound-issue update (target=jira_key) is now recognized in-scope and planned `mutate`, so the live coordinator+fuse reroute executes the write — restoring parity with the legacy `_build_filter_target_set` path. Non-test diff: 35 lines in one file.

## RED→GREEN (held out from the fix)
- Held-out oracle `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_sync_only_scalar_update_dispatch_heldout.py` drives `reconcile_once` through a CLEAN subprocess (an in-memory transport records `update_issue`), avoiding the pytest conftest module-seeding collision. RED before the fix (`sync --only` dropped the write) / GREEN after; the `--filter-local-ids` parity guard stays GREEN throughout.
- Mutation check (teeth): reverting the id-expansion returns the `--only` test to RED.
- Refactoring litmus: the oracle asserts observable transport calls, not internals.
- Pure-function teeth `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_scoped_selection_ids_af1b.py`: scoped expansion, unselected ticket NOT pulled in, create target unchanged.

## Regression + gates
Full reconciler unit suite `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` GREEN (3631 passed, 1 skipped). `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass. Plan-review (blast-escalated LLM tier) PASS + signed.

## Sibling sweep (Step 7)
- Axis 1 (construct): `plan_pass` has exactly ONE caller and there is exactly ONE `selection.ids` construction site — both the fixed site. `_scope_excluded` is only reached through that path. No other live instances.
- Axis 2 (parity): all sync surfaces (CLI/MCP/library) funnel through `reconcile_once → run_differs → plan_pass`, so the fix at that shared core covers every channel. The legacy `--filter-local-ids` channel was already correct (guarded by the parity test). No MISSING slots.
- Bonus: the same expansion corrects a latent `--except` case (an excepted bound ticket's jira-key-targeted update was not being excluded).

## Fix-safety
Restoration (restores parity with the legacy route), not creation. No new dependency. No pre-existing test weakened.

## Attribution
regression, caused_by 67d4-ecba-cf95-4353 (commit d49466b5). To be recorded on the bug close via `--caused-by`.

## Remaining
Awaiting Gerrit change 2305 gates (LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1). Live replication = the Jira DC External Integration lane, which must run GREEN before close.

## Symptom
The live Jira DC lane (jira-dc-harness in external-integration.yml) fails on two rich-text tests after change 2266 (bug f449 lag-free snapshot overlay) landed: (1) test_live_rich_text_renders_and_echo_is_safe — after _push_and_converge of a rich body, renderedFields.description is EMPTY (''), so the <h1> assertion fails; (2) test_live_rich_text_both_sides_conflict_keeps_local — the converged settle pass computes outbound totals [1] when a converged repeat must compute nothing.

## Root cause (CONFIRMED — see RCA comment)
A `sync --only`-generic apply-dispatch drop, NOT a codec/differ/overlay defect. Under the PRIMARY route `sync --only=<local_id>` (Mode.LIVE, route="sync"), run_differs builds the outbound scalar UPDATE on a BOUND issue with `target = jira_key`, then hands `ticket_planner.plan_pass` a selection whose `ids` are the SELECTED LOCAL IDS only. `_scope_excluded` compares the jira-key target against those local ids (`target not in ids`), classifies the in-scope update `scope_deferred`, and the live coordinator+fuse reroute skips the deferred plan — the write is dropped. The legacy `--filter-local-ids` route works because it scopes via `_build_filter_target_set` (LOCAL IDS ∪ bound JIRA KEYS). Because the description write never lands, remote stays None and every pass re-emits (symptom 2) and renders empty (symptom 1).

## Fix
In run_differs, expand the selection ids handed to the shadow planner to LOCAL IDS ∪ their BOUND JIRA KEYS (new pure helper `_scoped_selection_ids`, sourced from the mutations' own provenance — no binding_store I/O), mirroring the legacy `_build_filter_target_set`. A bound-issue update (target=jira_key) is then recognized in-scope and planned `mutate`, so the coordinator executes the write. The same expansion also corrects a latent `--except` case (an excepted ticket's jira-key-targeted update was not being excluded).

## Attribution
regression, caused_by 67d4-ecba-cf95-4353 (commit d49466b5, "Wire live coordinator+fuse non-create reroute"), which made the coordinator+fuse reroute the authoritative dispatch path without ensuring in-scope bound-issue updates classify `mutate`. The defective scope check was authored shadow-only in 6bcf548d (85f8) where it dropped nothing.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A scoped `sync --only` LIVE pass dispatches a bound issue's outbound scalar UPDATE to the transport write (RED before fix), verified by `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_sync_only_scalar_update_dispatch_heldout.py`.
- [ ] The `--filter-local-ids` parity guard stays GREEN in the same held-out oracle (no legacy regression).
- [ ] The pure helper `_scoped_selection_ids` expands a selected bound local id to include its jira key, does NOT pull in unselected tickets, and leaves a create's local-id target unchanged, verified by `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_scoped_selection_ids_af1b.py`.
- [ ] No regression in the reconciler unit suite: `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/`.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` pass.
- [ ] The live Jira DC External Integration lane (all three rich-text tests) runs GREEN in GitHub Actions.

## Testing
- Held-out RED→GREEN oracle (subprocess-driven reconcile_once with an in-memory transport): `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_sync_only_scalar_update_dispatch_heldout.py`. Mutation check: reverting the id-expansion returns the `--only` test to RED.
- Pure-function teeth: `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/apply/test_scoped_selection_ids_af1b.py`.
- Regression sweep: `python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/` (3631 passed), `make lint`, `make typecheck`.
- Live replication: the Jira DC External Integration lane exercises the real `sync --only` path against live Jira DC.
